violation_type.title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §746.203(2))

violation_type.typical_finding: Provider did not submit annual verification of liability insurance timely.

finding_variants.text: Provider did not submit annual verification of liability insurance timely.
The operation's Liability insurance was required to be updated on 10/4/24.
Proof of liability insurance was unavailabe for review during the inspection.

The operation does not have liability insurance.
